title: CLEAR Alert issued for 37-year-old man last seen on Northwest Side
text:
The Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) issued a CLEAR Alert for a missing and possibly endangered man who was last seen Sept. 16 on the Northwest Side.
10 suspects arrested after DART raid on Southwest Side, San Antonio police sayNEISD identifies 16 elementary schools that could be considered for closure– The Texas Department of Public Safety issued a CLEAR Alert for a missing and possibly endangered man who was last seen Sept. 16 on the Northwest Side.
According to DPS, Christopher Hicks, 37, was last spotted in the 9600 block of Stillwater Pass, which is outside Loop 1604 near Culebra Road. Authorities also said Hicks was last seen wearing a blue beanie, blue shirt, green and black shorts, black sandals, and carrying a black backpack with a silver holographic dragon design. Anyone with information on Hick’s whereabouts is urged to contact the Bexar County Sheriff’s Office at 210-335-4630.
